desc: Analyze the problem and determine the algorithm (KMP on $S^R + \# + S$ to find longest palindromic suffix).
Implement the KMP prefix function calculation.
Construct the string T as reverse(S) + '#' + S.
Calculate the longest palindromic suffix length L.
Construct the result by appending the reverse of the non-palindromic prefix part.
Handle edge cases like single character strings.
